title: Equisetum arvense essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Equisetum arvense essential oil is derived from the horsetail plant, known for its high concentration of silica and other bioactive compounds. In herbalism, it is valued for its purported ability to support joint health and detoxification processes in the body. This essential oil is often used in aromatherapy and topical applications to alleviate symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory conditions. It is also believed to aid in the removal of heavy metals and toxins from the body. However, due to its potency, it is typically diluted before use and should be handled with care.
